violations.why: Compute ISR (priority 6) can preempt the RR ISR in JudgeCondi between the two reads and change var1.
Compute ISR can preempt between the two reads of var2 and write it, so the reads can return different values.
Compute ISR can overwrite array[TRIGGER] after the FL ISR writes it and before the FL ISR reads it back.
Compute ISR can overwrite RT_h between the RR ISR's write and its later read.
Compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the RR ISR's write and its read.
Compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the FL ISR's write and its read.
Compute ISR can overwrite RT4 between the FR ISR's write and its read.
The FR ISR (equal priority) or the compute ISR can overwrite RT3 between the FL ISR's write and its read.
Compute ISR can overwrite RT2 between the FR ISR's write and its read.
